I wrote `component.html` in the folder. It's the Team screen at 1280px inside `#component`, static HTML and CSS only. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It follows `DESIGN.md`:
- **Page:** white background, one column up to 1120px wide, with the "TEAM" heading on the left and the "Invite Member" button on the right.
- **Members:** the five members sit in one bordered card. Each 52px row has the name, the email in the muted colour, and a role select.
- **Styling:** colours, spacing, radii and type sizes all come from the tokens in `tokens.css`, which I copied into the file's `<style>` block.
- **Selects:** they use the site's type and have an accessible label for each person.

- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't available in the folder, so the file falls back to system fonts unless those fonts are installed.
- **No column headers:** `DESIGN.md` asks for a label-style header row on lists. I left it out because you said to use exactly your content, so say if you want a "Member / Role" header row anyway.
